bxpStats.description:
A list of dictionaries containing stats for each boxplot. Required keys are:
(matplotlib bxpstats)

Python: list of dicts

positions.description:
Sets the positions of the boxes. The ticks and limits are automatically set to match the positions.

Python: array-like

widths.description:
Either a scalar or a vector and sets the width of each box. The default is 0.15*(distance between extreme positions), clipped to no less than 0.15 and no more than 0.5.

Python: array-like

vert.description: If True (default), makes the boxes vertical. If False, makes horizontal boxes.

patchArtist.description:
If False produces boxes with the Line2D artist. If True produces boxes with the Patch artist.
(matplotlib patch_artist)

showNotches.description:
If False (default), produces a rectangular box plot. If True, will produce a notched box plot
(matplotlib shownotches)

showMeans.description:
If True, will toggle on the rendering of the means
(matplotlib showmeans)

showCaps.description:
If True, will toggle on the rendering of the caps
(matplotlib showcaps)

showBox.description:
If True, will toggle on the rendering of the box
(matplotlib showbox)

showFliers.description:
If True, will toggle on the rendering of the fliers
(matplotlib showfliers)

boxProps.description:
If provided, will set the plotting style of the boxes
(matplotlib boxprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

whiskerProps.description:
If provided, will set the plotting style of the whiskers
(matplotlib whiskerprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

flierProps.description:
If provided will set the plotting style of the fliers
(matplotlib flierprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

medianProps.description:
If provided, will set the plotting style of the medians
(matplotlib medianprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

capProps.description:
If provided, will set the plotting style of the caps
(matplotlib capprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

meanProps.description:
If provided, will set the plotting style of the means
(matplotlib meanprops)

Python: dict or None (default)

meanLine.description:
If True (and showmeans is True), will try to render the mean as a line spanning the full width of the box according to meanprops. Not recommended if shownotches is also True. Otherwise, means will be shown as points.
(matplotlib meanline)

manageXTicks.description:
If the function should adjust the xlim and xtick locations.
(matplotlib manage_xticks)

zOrder.description:
The zorder of the resulting boxplot
(matplotlib zorder)

Python: scalar

name: PlotBxpSpec
